rows.label: qst500105_msg0002
rows.name:
It's been a long time since I met
anyone besides Nopon or Tirkin, mo.

rows.label: qst500105_msg0003
rows.name:
I'd like to hear about world affairs,
fashion trends, and life outside, mo!

rows.label: qst500105_msg0004
rows.name:
Mo-mo-mo?! Temitemi just remembered
the real purpose for coming here, mo!

rows.label: qst500105_msg0005
rows.name:
I came to Superbia looking for
ingredients to make delicious juice,
mo!

rows.label: qst500105_msg0006
rows.name:
But I lost badly at Pipe Jenga in Alba
Margen and ended up buried in debt...

rows.label: qst500105_msg0007
rows.name:
Then the Tirkin recruited me, and I
got used to having food, clothing, and
shelter provided here, mo...

rows.label: qst500105_msg0008
rows.name: I can't stay like this, mo!

rows.label: qst500105_msg0009
rows.name:
I'll take some Superbian ingredient
and head back to Avaritia Trading
Company, mo!

rows.label: qst500105_msg0010
rows.name: Thanks for talking to me, mo!

rows.label: qst500105_msg0011
rows.name:
Some of my other siblings are also
looking for juice ingredients, mo.

rows.label: qst500105_msg0012
rows.name:
If you meet them, please be as kind
to them as you were to me, mo!
